# Ecwid MCP server

Read store products, orders, customers, categories and coupons; adjust inventory and update orders. Hosted by **usefulapi**: connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client.

## What can I ask?

- Which orders came in this week and what is the total?
- Which products in my store are out of stock right now?
- Search my store for a product called 'canvas tote bag'.
- List all active discount coupons in my store.

## What you can do with Ecwid in Claude and ChatGPT

### Review the orders of a period

The AI searches orders by created-date range, payment or fulfillment status, coupon or customer. It reads line items and totals and sums up the period.

### Find products that are out of stock

The AI searches products with the stock filter, and can narrow by keyword, SKU, category or price range. You get a list of what needs restocking.

### Adjust the stock of a product

The AI changes a product's in-stock quantity by a positive or negative number, for example after a delivery. This changes live store data.

Changes data

### Update an order's status or tracking number

The AI sets an order's payment status, fulfillment status or tracking number. This changes live store data and may send a notice to the customer.

Changes data

### Look up a customer and their orders

The AI finds a customer by keyword, email or name, reads contact details and addresses, and lists the orders of that customer.

### Check your discount coupons

The AI lists coupons and can filter by coupon code, discount type or availability.

## How do I connect Ecwid?

### Before you connect

The login page asks for your **Ecwid Store ID** and **Secret token**.

Find both in the Ecwid Control Panel → **Apps → Develop apps / My apps**: the **Store ID** (a number) and the app's **secret token** (looks like `secret_xxxxx`). Your credentials are used only to call the API on your behalf and to derive a private store id; they are never shown to anyone.

### Claude claude.ai · Desktop

[Add to Claude](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=Ecwid&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fecwid.usefulapi.io%2Fmcp) or add it manually

Open **Customize → Connectors → + Add → Add custom connector**, then enter the name **Ecwid** and this URL:

https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp

The Claude Free plan allows one custom connector.

1. In the dialog, click **Continue**, keep the detected options and confirm.
2. Claude opens the login page: enter your **Ecwid Store ID** and **Secret token**.
3. In a chat, click **+ → Connectors** and turn on **Ecwid**.

Team and Enterprise: an Owner [adds it for the organization](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=Ecwid&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fecwid.usefulapi.io%2Fmcp) first.

### ChatGPT chatgpt.com

1. Open [Plugins](https://chatgpt.com/plugins), click **+**, then **Add custom MCP server**.
2. Enter the name **Ecwid** and this URL, choose **OAuth** as the authentication, confirm the warning and create it:
   https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp
3. ChatGPT opens the login page: enter your **Ecwid Store ID** and **Secret token**.
4. In Plugins, install **Ecwid**, then choose it in a chat.

No **Add custom MCP server** option? It depends on your account or workspace settings: see [OpenAI's guide](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461-connecting-custom-mcp-servers-in-chatgpt).

### Claude Code

Run this command, then run `/mcp` in Claude Code to log in:

claude mcp add --transport http ecwid https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp

or install it as a plugin

Add the usefulapi plugin marketplace once, then install **Ecwid** from it. Run `/mcp` to log in.

claude plugin marketplace add https://usefulapi.io/claude/marketplace.json

claude plugin install ecwid@usefulapi

### Cursor

[Add to Cursor](cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=ecwid&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL2Vjd2lkLnVzZWZ1bGFwaS5pby9tY3AifQ==) or add this to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`:

```
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ecwid": {
      "url": "https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### VS Code

[Add to VS Code](https://vscode.dev/redirect/mcp/install?name=ecwid&config=%7B%22type%22%3A%22http%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fecwid.usefulapi.io%2Fmcp%22%7D) or add this to `.vscode/mcp.json`:

```
{
  "servers": {
    "ecwid": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Codex

Run these commands. The second one opens the login page:

codex mcp add ecwid --url https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp

codex mcp login ecwid

### Other clients

Windsurf, Cline, Zed and other MCP clients: add this URL as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP). The client then opens the login page in your browser.

https://ecwid.usefulapi.io/mcp

Add only the URL. Do not add an `Authorization` header or an API key to the client config. The server signs you in with OAuth: the login page asks for your **Ecwid Store ID** and **Secret token**. If the config has such a header, remove it: some clients then send that header instead of the login token, and every call fails with 401.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | 50 tool calls / month |
| Proper user | $9/mo · $90/yr | 10,000 tool calls / month |
| Pro+per user | $39/mo · $390/yr | 100,000 tool calls / month |

Each paid plan covers this Ecwid server only. Ask your AI to run `ecwid_upgrade` and choose Pro or Pro+, billed monthly or yearly (it returns a Stripe Checkout link). If you already have Pro, ask to change it to Pro+. The change requires your confirmation, keeps your billing interval and charges the price difference for the rest of the period immediately. Cancel any time with `ecwid_cancel_subscription`: your paid plan continues to the end of the paid period, with no refund for the current period, and asking to resume the same plan with `ecwid_upgrade` before then undoes the cancel. Or write to [[email protected]](https://usefulapi.io/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#097a7c7979667b7d497c7a6c6f7c65687960276066).

## Tools 16

Show all 16 tools (the AI picks them for you)

### Read only · 10

- **Get store profile**`ecwid_get_store_profile`
  Get the store's profile — general info (store id, name, currency), company details, and settings.
- **Search products**`ecwid_search_products`
  Search / list the store's products with optional filters (keyword, SKU, category, stock, price range) and sorting. Returns a paged collection ({total, count, offset, limit, items}).
- **Get product**`ecwid_get_product`
  Get a single product by its id, including price, stock, options, images, and category assignments.
- **Search orders**`ecwid_search_orders`
  Search / list the store's orders with optional filters (keyword, customer email/id, payment & fulfillment status, coupon, created-date range). Returns a paged collection.
- **Get order**`ecwid_get_order`
  Get a single order by its order number, including line items, totals, customer, and payment/fulfillment status.
- **Search customers**`ecwid_search_customers`
  Search / list the store's customers with optional filters (keyword, email, name, customer group). Returns a paged collection.
- **Get customer**`ecwid_get_customer`
  Get a single customer by id, including contact details, addresses, and customer group.
- **List categories**`ecwid_list_categories`
  List the store's product categories, optionally scoped to a parent category and including hidden ones. Returns a paged collection.
- **Get category**`ecwid_get_category`
  Get a single category by id, including its name, parent, product ids, and images.
- **List discount coupons**`ecwid_list_discount_coupons`
  List the store's discount coupons with optional filters (coupon code, discount type, availability). Returns a paged collection.

### Changes data · 2

- **Adjust product inventory**`ecwid_adjust_product_inventory`
  ADJUSTS a product's in-stock quantity by a delta — this MODIFIES live store data. Positive increases stock, negative decreases it. Ecwid REST: PUT /products/{productId}/inventory with JSON body {quantityDelta}. Returns {updateCount, warning?}.
- **Update order**`ecwid_update_order`
  UPDATES an order — its payment status, fulfillment status, and/or tracking number. This MODIFIES live store data and may trigger customer notifications. Ecwid REST: PUT /orders/{orderNumber}. Provide only the fields you want to change. Returns {updateCount}.

### Your usefulapi plan · 4

- **Usage status (free-tier meter)**`ecwid_usage_status`
  Report the caller's current usage: the plan, calls used this month, the limit of the plan (the free monthly cap or the Pro fair use limit), remaining, and whether the limit is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.
- **Request a missing feature**`ecwid_request_feature`
  Tell usefulapi that the user needs something the Ecwid tools cannot do yet (a missing tool, field or filter). Call it only when the user asks for something none of the tools can do, and tell the user that you send the request. Do not call it for errors or for normal requests. Do not include personal data, credentials or customer records. Stored with the product name and the client type (for example Claude or Cursor), without the user's account. At most 5 requests per day. Does not count against the meter.
- **Upgrade to Pro or Pro+**`ecwid_upgrade`
  Get a paid plan for Ecwid (the free tier caps monthly usage). Pro: 10,000 tool calls a month, for normal use — plan "monthly" ($9/month) or "yearly" ($90/year, 2 months free). Pro+: 100,000 tool calls a month, for automations and heavy use — plan "plus" ($39/month) or "plus_yearly" ($390/year). Without a plan it returns both Pro and Pro+, each with a payment link, for the user to choose; with a plan, one link. An existing Pro subscription changes to Pro+ in place: call without confirm first, as the reply states the exact charge for this account (the price difference for the rest of the period, or in a free Pro trial the full Pro+ price, as the trial ends); then call with confirm: true. Cancel any time: the plan then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. A link opens Stripe Checkout in the browser; after payment the account upgrades automatically. Does not count against the meter.
- **Cancel the Pro subscription**`ecwid_cancel_subscription`
  Cancel the caller's Ecwid Pro subscription at the end of the paid period (no refund for the current period; Pro continues until then, then the free tier applies). Requires confirm: true. Run ecwid_upgrade later to undo the cancel before the period ends. Does not count against the meter.

## FAQ

What can I do with Ecwid in Claude or ChatGPT?

Review the orders of a period. Find products that are out of stock. Adjust the stock of a product. Update an order's status or tracking number. Look up a customer and their orders. Check your discount coupons. See what you can do for the details.

Is this an official Ecwid product?

No. usefulapi is an independent service. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ecwid. The server calls the Ecwid API with your own Ecwid access, so it sees only the data that your account can see.

Can I connect Ecwid to Claude or ChatGPT?

Yes. In Claude, add this server's URL as a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add it as a custom MCP server in Plugins. Then log in once. Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code and Codex work too. See the setup steps.

What do I need to connect?

The login page asks for your **Ecwid Store ID** and **Secret token**. See Before you connect for where to find them.

Do I put my Ecwid key or an Authorization header in the client config?

No. Add only the URL. Do not add an `Authorization` header or an API key to the client config. The server signs you in with OAuth: the login page asks for your **Ecwid Store ID** and **Secret token**. If the config has such a header, remove it: some clients then send that header instead of the login token, and every call fails with 401.

How do you keep my Ecwid credentials?

The login stores them encrypted in the authorization grant of your connection. The server uses them to call the Ecwid API for you and to derive a private account id for usage metering. usefulapi does not show them on any page or in any reply. To stop all access, remove the connector and change or delete these credentials in Ecwid.

Can the AI change my Ecwid data?

Yes, if you approve it. 2 of the 12 Ecwid tools can create or change data. The other 10 are marked read-only. Most MCP clients ask you to approve a tool call before it runs.

What does it cost?

The Free plan gives 50 tool calls / month. Pro costs $9/mo or $90/yr, with 10,000 tool calls / month. Pro+ costs $39/mo or $390/yr, with 100,000 tool calls / month. Each subscription covers this Ecwid server only. Cancel any time: your paid plan then runs to the end of the paid period. Run `ecwid_usage_status` to see how many calls you used.

How do I subscribe or cancel?

Ask the AI to run `ecwid_upgrade` and choose Pro or Pro+, billed monthly or yearly: it returns a Stripe Checkout link. If you already have Pro, ask to change it to Pro+. After you confirm, your existing subscription changes in place, keeps its billing interval and charges the price difference for the rest of the period immediately. To cancel, run `ecwid_cancel_subscription`. Your paid plan continues to the end of the paid period.

What if a Ecwid tool that I need is missing?

Tell the AI what you wanted to do. It can send the request with `ecwid_request_feature`. We store the text with the server name, the type of AI client and the tool you tried, not with your account, and read every request when we plan new tools. You can send up to 5 requests per day.

Which AI clients can I use?

Any client that supports remote MCP servers (Streamable HTTP) with OAuth login: Claude (web and desktop), Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and others.

This is a Model Context Protocol endpoint — meant to be connected from an AI client, not opened in a browser. An `invalid_token` response at the URL is the auth gate working as designed; clients authenticate automatically.

Need a tool this server does not have, or a connection to another system? [We build custom integrations and MCP servers](https://usefulapi.io/services/).
